column1: # --- URL VERIFICATION of every github.com address this pass publishes (17 addresses) ---
# 🔴 HTTP status is NOT a usable existence oracle in this environment: `curl -L` over
# github.com HTML returns 403 for ALL 17 addresses uniformly, including the two this pass
# promoted and read licence bytes from.  That is the proxy refusing HTML browsing, not a
# statement about any repository, and a pass that read it as 404-ish would have discarded
# every row it had just verified.  This is ACTION p293's rule on a new channel: a blanket
# refusal is a MEASUREMENT OF THE CHANNEL, never an inconclusive result about the subject.
# 🟢 The oracle that works is `git ls-remote`, and raw.githubusercontent.com serves payloads
# normally, which is how every licence byte in this file was read.
